setting.name: Disable Microsoft Office Telemetry
setting.casual_explanation: This writes Office policy values that turn off logging, uploads, feedback, and several telemetry reporting buckets.
setting.why_people_change_it: People change it when they want Office to send less telemetry and feedback data from the current user profile.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: The bundle is explicit and reversible, but it still ships only through the first-party provider and is not yet a validated research-provider card.
setting.professional_notes: The current app still exposes this tweak through app/Services/TweakProviders/PrivacyTweakProvider.cs and engine/Tweaks/Misc/DisableOfficeTelemetryTweak.cs. The current engine tweak writes coordinated HKCU policy values under Office\16.0\OSM and related common feedback paths. This record keeps the live behavior documented without publishing it as a validated research-provider card yet.
